p4RecordPCM.summary: Starts a bounded microphone recording and waits for it to finish. Save the returned handle and release it after use.
p4RecordPCM.returns: Audio handle, or 0 if the request fails.
prerequisites: Import P4 Audio and its declared dependencies.
inputs: 1. record PCM for: number; library example 1000.

examples.title: Use record PCM for … milliseconds
examples.explanation: Block notation: Starts a bounded microphone recording and waits for it to finish. Save the returned handle and release it after use. Audio handle, or 0 if the request fails.

examples.title: Capture, inspect, release
examples.code:
set clip to (record PCM for [1000] milliseconds)
if (audio [clip] valid?)
  audio [clip] RMS level
  release audio [clip]
examples.explanation: This example explicitly records the microphone for one second. Release the retained clip after all consumers have finished; the RMS value is PCM level, not dB SPL.

notes: Explicit bounded ES8311 recording, 20 to 8000 milliseconds, 16000 Hz mono signed PCM16. Two native handles, 512000-byte total budget. Release clips when finished. Transport, timing, cleanup and controlled microphone acoustic response are tested. Speech recognition and wake-word listening require their separate model profiles. Recording is off at startup and Stop All cancels it.
Source: boards\waveshare_esp32p4_wifi6\integration\P4_Audio.ubl. Examples are illustrative block notation, not hardware acceptance tests.
